title: Harnessing the Power of Artificial Intelligence to Vitalize Endangered Indigenous Languages: Technologies and Experiences

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying cultural contamination by manually inspecting translation outputs to determine the frequency of explicit or implicit Biblical terminology and Christian expressions when translating non-religious Indigenous texts.

Evaluating the historical underrepresentation and lack of digital resources for endangered Indigenous languages by analyzing the performance, memorization issues, and usability of fine-tuned machine translation models on ultra-low-resource datasets.
